available_evidence_sources.quote: The main advance is a broader conditional algorithm, not another small numerical fixture. For the acquired decomposition `J=D0+S+A_+A_+^T-N`, the positive conditional variance inequality gives the all-tilt trace bound `Tr Cov(Y_-) <= p beta Tr(N)/(1-alpha)`. Conditional independence between sites, not between times within a site, makes the trace sum `p M delta=p beta`. This removes time-mesh size from the negative rejection exponent while still charging vector dimension, sampling and arithmetic. A finite sampled center and the correctly shifted positive normalizer supply the construction; an optimal-center oracle is not assumed.
